fv3_lin_rood_ppm_1d.accuracy: O(h^3) on smooth profiles where the CW84 limiter is inactive; degrades to O(h) at active monotonicity-limiter constraints.
composes: flux_1d_ppm — Colella & Woodward (1984) CW84 PPM Courant-integral face flux (see discretizations/finite_volume/flux_1d_ppm.json for the full AST)
FV flux-divergence tendency: T_i = -(F_{i+1/2} * dx_{i+1/2} - F_{i-1/2} * dx_{i-1/2}) / A_i
fv3_lin_rood_ppm_1d.reference: Colella & Woodward (1984) JCP 54(1):174-201; Lin & Rood (1996) MWR 124(9):2046-2070. Full PPM flux AST in sibling catalog rule flux_1d_ppm.json. This inner-rule entry identifies the 1D PPM advection operator used by fv3_lin_rood_advection along each axis; the ESD sweep loop in src/operators/transport_2d.jl::transport_2d_linrood! orchestrates the per-axis applications via flux_1d_ppm! and _advective_tendency!.

schema_gaps.comment: This inner rule is part of the fv3_lin_rood_advection dimensional-split composite. The full PPM flux AST (CW84 edge reconstruction, limiter, Courant-integral) lives in flux_1d_ppm.json to avoid duplication. A future ESS schema feature — a cross-file inner_rule reference or an explicit 'delegates_to' field — would allow this entry to be a pointer rather than a structural duplicate. Until that lands, this entry carries only the structural identity (applies_to, grid_family, composes) needed for the dimensional-split composite to declare it as its inner operator.

fv3_lin_rood_advection.accuracy: O(dt^2) in time (Strang-like symmetric Lin-Rood correction); O(h^3) in space (PPM) on smooth profiles
fv3_lin_rood_advection.reference: Lin & Rood (1996) MWR 124(9):2046-2070, eqs. (8)-(13). Dimensionally-split 2D PPM advection on the gnomonic cubed sphere with Lin-Rood half-step advective correction for uniform mixing-ratio preservation. The splitting departs from canonical Strang in that the half-step updates use the ADVECTIVE tendency form (not the flux form), which eliminates first-order splitting errors in convergent/divergent flow while maintaining conservation. Imperative reference: src/operators/transport_2d.jl::transport_2d_linrood!. ESD owns the sweep loop; the per-axis PPM flux computations delegate to flux_1d_ppm! (src/operators/flux_1d.jl).
fv3_lin_rood_advection.notes: Lin-Rood splitting (Lin & Rood 1996 eq. 13): q^theta = q^n + (1/2)*dt*g_adv[v*,q^n] (advective half-step in eta); q^lambda = q^n + (1/2)*dt*f_adv[u*,q^n] (advective half-step in xi); q^{n+1} = q^n + dt*(F_flux[u*,q^theta] + G_flux[v*,q^lambda]) (full flux step). The advective half-steps preserve uniform mixing ratios in divergent flow; the flux full-step conserves mass. Cross-panel boundary flux matching (_match_rotated_boundary_fluxes! in src/operators/flux_1d.jl) is applied to the raw per-axis fluxes before converting to tendencies, ensuring exact conservation across panel joins.
fv3_lin_rood_advection.panel_handling: Same convention as transport_2d.json: in-panel (xi, eta) offsets only. Cross-panel ghost extension and basis rotation live in the cubed_sphere accessor (src/grids/panel_connectivity.jl) below the rule layer.
fv3_lin_rood_advection.sweep_consumes_declaration: The dimensional_split declaration is read by the ESD sweep loader in src/operators/transport_2d.jl. Fields `axes`, `inner_rule`, and `splitting` map to: axes=[xi,eta] -> iterate over grid.xi and grid.eta; inner_rule=fv3_lin_rood_ppm_1d -> per-axis PPM via flux_1d_ppm! + _advective_tendency!; splitting=strang -> Lin-Rood symmetric half/full step sequence (see notes).
